lines.en: Lesson 121
The man in a hat
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
Why didn't Caroline recognize the customer straight away?
lines.zh: 为什么卡罗琳没有立刻认出这位顾客？

lines.en: I bought two expensive dictionaries here half an hour ago, but I forgot to take them with me.
lines.zh: 半小时前我在这儿买了词典，可是我忘记把它们带走了。

lines.en: Who served you, sir?
The lady who is standing behind the counter.
lines.zh: 是那位站在柜台后面的女士。

lines.en: Which books did you buy?
The books which are on the counter.
Did you serve this gentleman half an hour ago, Caroline?
lines.zh: 半小时前你为这位先生服务过吗，卡罗琳？

lines.en: He says he's the man who bought these books.
lines.zh: 他说他就是买这些书的人。

lines.en: I can't remember.
The man who I served was wearing a hat.
lines.zh: 我为之服务的那个人戴着一顶帽子。

lines.en: Have you got a hat, sir?
Yes, I have.
Would you put it on, please?
All right.
Is this the man that you served, Caroline?
lines.zh: 卡罗琳，这就是您为之服务过的那个人吗？

lines.en: Yes.
I recognize him now.
